responsibility: Defines the companion vector scheduling model used with generic out-of-order RISC-V tuning. It models a separate RVV issue queue and vector execution resources, with reservations for vector loads/stores, segment accesses, ALU ops, permutes, reductions, mask instructions, div/sqrt, crypto families, vsetvl, and vector CSR-like operations, providing the scheduler with RVV-specific latency and throughput assumptions that complement generic-ooo.md’s scalar model.
